title: Adversarial capability-acquisition stress test
candidate: C45 rung-20 mechanism stack, frozen before evaluation
objective: Test whether the rung-20 gain survives task-distribution shift, misleading structural cues, explicit mechanism ablation and sham controls.

gates.full_beats_baseline_residual: C45 full lower mean residual than baseline
gates.full_beats_baseline_vcgc: C45 full higher VCGC than baseline
gates.seed_majority: wins on both primary directions in at least 5 of 7 seeds
gates.family_robustness: no task family has more than 10 percent VCGC regression versus baseline
gates.sham_separation: C45 full beats sham on residual and VCGC
gates.ablation_signal: at least two named ablations worsen residual or VCGC versus full candidate

claim_limit: Synthetic robustness evidence only. Passing does not establish general intelligence, AGI or superintelligence.
